# Cochran, Kroll & Associates, P.C.

> Michigan-based medical malpractice and personal injury law firm specializing in birth injuries, wrongful death, vehicle accidents, and surgical errors.

Cochran, Kroll & Associates, P.C. is a full-service personal injury and medical malpractice law firm serving Michigan clients. Led by attorneys Eileen Kroll, Terry Cochran, and Rula Aoun, the firm handles complex cases including birth injuries, wrongful death claims, emergency room errors, and vehicle accident injuries on a contingency fee basis.
